**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Does this feature benefit a specific tier or group? (Check all that apply):**
- [ ] Free Tier Users (Upload limits, interactive QA)
- [ ] Pro Tier Users (e.g., One-click PDF generation of step-by-step answers)
- [ ] Academic Instructors / Professors (e.g., autogenerating class quizzes)
- [ ] Developer Experience / Infrastructure (Supabase, Pinecone, Razorpay, Gemini integration)

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context, designs, or mockups about the feature request here.
